data.screening_set: completed fixture with kickoff_utc >= 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z and kickoff_utc < 2026-08-23T00:00:00Z
data.source_rule: Use only fixed local artifacts already present for Task A and its known 2026 factor captures; no acquisition, source substitution, or source choice after results.
data.source_path_and_sha_reporting: The boundary-first loader records paths and SHA-256 after it exists; paths are not selected using factor results.

loader.inspection_output: field names, source counts, loaded monthly counts, exclusion counts, and assertion counts only; never row contents

F5_RECENT_AH_COVER.value: home_cover_rate-away_cover_rate from canonical historical AH facts strictly before target kickoff

F1_MARKET_MOVEMENT.value: AH market_movement_factor score = clip(-first_seen_to_current/0.25,-1,1), using only snapshots captured no later than target as-of

F2_BOOKMAKER_INTENT.value: Signed AH infer_bookmaker_intent signal_strength: HOME_LEAN positive, AWAY_LEAN negative, BALANCED or CONFLICTED zero; insufficient/leakage-blocked is missing

candidate_model.form: One standardized scalar X and one fitted coefficient beta; no intercept, interaction, feature engineering, or hyperparameter search.
candidate_model.axis: candidate_delta = baseline_delta + beta*X; total unchanged; reconstruct lambdas as (total+delta)/2 and (total-delta)/2 with current lambda clamps.
candidate_model.standardization: Mean and population standard deviation fit only on the four fitting folds.
candidate_model.coefficient_fit: Minimize multiclass log-loss on fitting folds by deterministic golden-section search over beta in [-2,2] for 96 iterations; report a boundary solution and do not widen or refit.
candidate_model.evaluation: Five deterministic fixture-cluster OOF folds assigned by int(sha256(fixture_id)[:8],16)%5. Fit on four folds and score the held-out fold; pool each fixture's single OOF prediction.
candidate_model.near_constant: population_std == 0 on any required fitting cohort yields FAIL_NEAR_CONSTANT

baseline.optional_inputs: home_elo=None, away_elo=None, home_squad_value_eur=None, away_squad_value_eur=None, lineup adjustments zero and disabled
baseline.probability_model: Exact independent Poisson score matrix normalized on goals 0..10, then aggregated to HOME/DRAW/AWAY

inference.seed_reason: Avoid reusing Task A's bootstrap resampling sequence.
inference.resampling: Sample pooled OOF fixture IDs with replacement and retain all three class components together.
inference.one_sided_lower_95: 5th percentile of bootstrap mean paired Brier improvements
inference.pass_rule: OOF Brier improvement > 0, one-sided 95% lower bound > 0, and p < 0.016667. All other outcomes FAIL. PASS means screen-in for future confirmation only.

required: OOF Brier improvement, one-sided 95% lower bound, p-value, and corrected-alpha result
log-loss, ECE, reliability, and resolution baseline and candidate
min, p25, median, p75, max, population_std, and zero count
usable fixture count and fixture-cluster count
loaded monthly counts, all exclusions, and loader assertion counts
explicit statement that the clean confirmation set was not consumed

known_limitation: Fixture-level bootstrap does not cluster repeated fixtures from the same team-season; intervals may be slightly narrow.
stopping_rule: Run once, report once, stop. Do not change family, boundaries, scalar, axis, model, optimizer, metrics, bootstrap, missing policy, or threshold after seeing results.
